name: sigmar
description: Sigmar is a casual, display specific webfont. It's design is based upon various fonts found in mid twentieth century pulp magazine advertising. It's an improved version of Sigmar One , whose small caps have been replaced by basic lower cases, for the Summer of Type in 2023. To contribute, see github.com/googlefonts/sigmarone .
